name: Premium Champion Pack EX × M × BREAK

releases.name: Premium Champion Pack EX × M × BREAK

description.text: A special pack of the XY BREAK series released on 16 April 2016, reprinting strong tournament cards in holo. Every card is holo, and each ten-card pack, one of them an Energy, held at least one Pokémon-EX, M Pokémon or BREAK Evolution, as its name says. M Rayquaza-EX, Mewtwo-EX with both of its Megas, Hoopa-EX and Shaymin-EX are among the reprints, and new cards such as Beedrill-EX and Wobbuffet BREAK joined them. The cards are numbered to 131. Japanese Wikipedia counts it as the forerunner of the later high-class packs.
